items.en: A person is a person through other people
items.meaning: You become who you are through your community. The Tshivenda form of ubuntu.

items.en: A home is built by people

items.ve: Nwana a sa lili u fela nembeleloni
items.en: A child who does not cry dies on the back
items.meaning: Speak up about your needs or nobody will know to help you.

items.ve: Mudi a u tou dzula u tshi vhonala
items.en: A homestead is not seen without effort
